title: sleep tight
summary: A '90s Indonesian TV ad for a mosquito coil that never existed: a mosquito gang, a sleepless father, and smoke that makes a fist. Played off a worn tape on a curved tube.
medium: animated commercial, canvas 2d + web audio, single file
